text:
sam: Heads up 1: overnight we shipped the batching improvements. A few partners report a subtle embedding regression vs. baseline. Need to pick sprint focus: immediate bugback vs. larger UX telemetry work.

nora: Which partners and what magnitude? Any revenue impact?

li: Surfaced by Customer X, Y during overnight smoke. Delta: cosine similarity drop ~0.02 on a 1k sample, failing mostly on long-tail prompts. No customer outage but embeddings-based recall dropped noticeably in their test harness.

devon: On-call logs show an uptick in dropped tokens when batch size spikes to >64. I suspect alignment with recent sampler change.

maria: Quick options: (A) Bug patch that reverts the sampler tweak (2 eng days) and run a focused eval; (B) Keep change, do broader telemetry + gating UI (4-5 eng days + design) to let customers control batching policy per-route.

sam: Also consider commercial tradeoff: a revert fixes risk fast but delays planned latency refactor that saves $X/month for customers.

li: We should quantify risk: run internal eval against customer-provided prompts. If regression >0.015 for Customer X or Y, escalate to hotfix. Nora, can you ask them for 50 representative prompts?

nora: On it. I'll PM both and request samples and their test script. ETA 3h.

devon: I can prepare a canary config and quick rollback plan. Canary command: `infra rollout --service=embed-worker --pct=5 --window=6h`. We should capture per-customer embedding drift in the probe.

maria: UX/PD note: adding per-route batching toggle requires Console UI + API surface. Design quick mock in 1 day, dev ~2 days. Also need docs and a note in release email.

sam: Decision tree proposal: Step 1: run targeted eval with customer prompts within 12h. Step 2: if drift >0.015 for any paying customer, cut a revert hotfix and canary it for 6h. Step 3: parallel work on telemetry and per-route knob for Sprint N+1.

li: I'll queue the eval and post results here. Also instrument drift metric into the canary probe.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled by devon at 1946001200 1: embed-worker @5% 1: status: scheduled

nora: Customer X sent 60 prompts. Uploading to shared drive now.

maria: If we go hotfix, we should update the roadmap doc and note impacts to the latency refactor milestone (shift by one sprint). Who owns communicating to sales?

sam: Nora to draft customer-facing note if we do hotfix + offer a private runbook. Sarah from sales to be looped.

devon: If hotfix is needed, rollback play: `infra rollback --service=embed-worker --to=stable-2026-03-18` and pin variant. Also prepare tracing to capture sampler input distribution.

li: Eval done: Customer X drift = 0.022, Customer Y = 0.006. Signal is actionable for X.

sam: Given that, we should do hotfix now. Maria, spin down refactor tasks and reallocate two engineers to the patch.

maria: Acknowledged. I'll update sprint board and mark refactor delayed.

nora: Drafting the customer note: apology, quick steps (we recommend revert while we ship per-route knob) and offer 1:1 run with their SRE. Will send to Sam for review.

devon: Initiating canary now.

deploy-bot: canary started by devon at 1946001400 1: embed-worker @5% 1: status: in_progress

li: Monitoring drift plot. If it falls under 0.01 after revert we'll widen rollout.

sam: Final call: bug-first hotfix + sprint N+1 UX/telemetry followup. Keep roadmap notes and update stakeholders. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
